summary: Lane B target 8 (weak (1,1), strong (p,p), Lebesgue differentiation from Mathlib) is already complete on main; this is a second round of satellites around that finished estimate, and the real-valued/`MemLp` repackaging has no in-repo or roadmap-named consumer. The `1 ≤ p` a.e.-finiteness lemma is a fine generalisation of merged material; the `toReal`/`MemLp` block is not.
